chapter_title: The Three Earths that Exist, they bear Fruit.
spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation


**
¶1:**
 Three grounds
 of
 reception
 exist within
 the whole
 person
, and each
 is being cultiv
ated by
 the Divine
. At first they receive
 the working
 of the Lord
 within them. Afterwards they yield
 genuine
 goods
 of
 life to
 the
 powers
 that labor
 upon them.

**¶2
:** The
 first
 of
 these is the natural
 mind —
 the ou
termost plane
 upon
 which human
 beings consc
iously d
well. They break
 it
 open with effort
, applying
 natural truths forc
ibly
 against
 what
 is hardened there
;
 they prepare
 the understanding in
 ordered
 arrangements
 to
 receive what
 is s
own,
 over
tur
ning its
 native
 orientation away
 from self
 and
 toward heaven.
 Afterwards
 they gather the goods
 of
 life that
 are
 produced from
 it
.

**¶3:** The
 second ground
 of
 reception is the interior spiritual mind,
 which
 is
 alive
 from the Divine
 and set
 apart
 as
 holy
. It is dispersed through every level
 of consciousness, both the
 higher
 and the
 lower. The powers
 that cultiv
ate it are Divine
 Love
 and Divine Wisdom, which
 flow contin
ually through all heavenly states. They
 labor
 upon
 the interior mind
 and
 tend
 it
, so that whatever
 good
 and truth lies
 hidden
 there
 may
 be drawn up
ward toward conjunction with themselves
. And that
 good
 rises
 and
 asc
ends into
 elevated
 states.
 It is
 lifted
 out from every lower
 plane
 in
 which it had
 been held
 capt
ive,
 and it is gathered
 into the Divine
,
 aug
menting the heavenly kingdom.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Three earths exist in the universe, and are being toiled over. At first they [receive] the farmer in them. Afterwards they bear [good] fruit to they who toil over them.

One of them is this great earth that people are living upon. They are ploughing in it [...], it with iron hoes, they cultivate, [making] the furrows, turning it over [...] Afterwards they harvest fruit from [it ...]

The second field is the living soul, the holy one. It is mixed in the entire zone, above and below. The farmers who toil over it are these two great light-givers, which journey through the heavens. They are toiling and cultivating it, so that they will draw it towards their aspect. And it leaps up and comes to the heights. It goes upwards, out from every place wherein it is, and it adds to them.
